abilities.name: Proud Lion
abilities.original: Posing to a <color=#B6F>wild</color> crowd after kills gives allies a damage and speed boost
abilities.proposed: Posing to a <color=#B6F>wild</color> crowd after kills gives you and all allies +40% damage and +20% movement speed for 10s.

abilities.name: Lethal Eagle
abilities.proposed: Melee kills ready your next powerful throw for 8s. That throw deals +100% direct-impact damage; launching a projectile consumes the effect.

abilities.name: Mighty Bear
abilities.original: More health, less movement speed.\nAttacks with blunt weapons deal 20% more damage and briefly stun
abilities.proposed: Base health +25%, movement speed -20%.\nBlunt weapons deal +20% damage; blunt melee hits impose at least 0.3s base stun.
